description: The same documents, a different desk, a different outcome. Everyone who deals with these systems knows this, and nobody can demonstrate it in their own case.
energy_note: Refused by someone who was having a bad morning.

aspect: Discretion is unappealable because it is discretion
description: Where the decision-maker is entitled to weigh factors, there is no error of law. Being wrongly assessed is not a ground of appeal; being unlawfully assessed is, and from outside the two are indistinguishable.
energy_note: Not wrong enough to appeal, wrong enough to end it.

aspect: The informal payment is the shadow price of discretion
description: A decision that can go either way is a decision that can be sold. Every discretionary step in DOC-002, AIR-004 and POL-001 has a tariff for exactly this reason.

They apply on the same day, with the same sponsor, the same bank statements and the same itinerary, for the same wedding. One is issued and one is refused, and the refusal letter cites intent to return.
